answer: Hydrokinetic attestation mitigates Sybil attacks by binding agent identities to fluid turbulence measured along a monitored river. Nodes log local vorticity fluctuations and verify them against a regional telemetry haven. An attacker incurs the verifiable cost of deploying physical fluid sensors per identity, preventing the creation of hollow virtual agents. However, seasonal droughts can suppress water flow, flattening turbulence signatures and falsely rejecting honest nodes.
